svg.aria-label: Where CDK9 and its counter-targets sit in the CDK family
svg.title: The protein space
svg.text: Sequence identity across the CDK family. Whole kinase region on the left, the 18 ATP-site positions on the right.
The pocket is far more conserved than the domain around it.
Whole-region identity understates how hard this is.
orange: differs from CDK9. The hinge is where CDK12 and CDK13 diverge; CDK7 matches CDK9 there and differs elsewhere.
A harder pair sits in the same family
CDK8 and CDK19 are identical at all 18 ATP-site positions (100%).
CDK4 / CDK6 sit at 94%. Natural scale-up targets once the chain holds on ours.
UniProt sequences. ATP-site positions mapped from CDK2 by sequence alignment, not structural superposition, so treat as indicative. tools/fetch_protein_space.py → data/protein-space.json
